name: VTK Legacy Binary File Writing
aliases: RSM Volume to VTR Export (Inline Binary)
definition: Writes a 3D RSM volume to a portable .vtr file using inline binary data mode (base64-encoded inside element content) to avoid VTK appended data parsing issues in older readers like ParaView 5.9.1.
summary: VTK Legacy Binary File Writing exports 3D volumes to VTR files using inline base64 binary data to ensure compatibility with older readers.
